commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Michael Oliver has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+7' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Gianluigi Donnarumma is alert and denies him with a nice save.
90+5' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+4' 1 - 1 Goal! 1:1. The ball rebounds to Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
90+4' Great save! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Gianluigi Donnarumma.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 8:2.
90+1' Reece James (Chelsea) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Gianluigi Donnarumma.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Liam Delap (Chelsea) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
88' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) attempts to feed Erling Haaland with a chip pass, but Filip Jorgensen reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
87' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
85' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester City.
81' Phil Foden (Manchester City) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Erling Haaland, but Filip Jorgensen displays great awareness to stop him.
81' Pep Guardiola is forced to make a change. Ruben Dias (Manchester City) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Nathan Ake.
80' The game is interrupted now, Ruben Dias (Manchester City) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' This is a yellow card! Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
79' Unsporting behaviour by Liam Delap (Chelsea). Liam Delap (Chelsea) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

78' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends a long through ball to Liam Delap, but he fails to control it properly and loses it to one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
76' Phil Foden (Manchester City) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
76' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
76' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

75' Phil Foden is able to continue with the attacking effort as he latches on to a beautiful defence-splitting lofted pass, which was supplied by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City). Phil Foden (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Manchester City force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
73' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.

70' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Tijjani Reijnders is replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).

63' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

59' PENALTY APPEAL after Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

58' A terrific piece of skill by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten.

57' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
57' Phil Foden (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

56' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

51' It doesn’t look good for Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
50' Looks like Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
49' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) gets on the end of a pass from Enzo Fernandez inside the box and quickly shoots, but the effort goes inches over the bar.
48' Neat passing move from Chelsea in order to create new attacking opportunities.

39' What a chance that is! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
38' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

38' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Filip Jorgensen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Manchester City have a corner.
